items.title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand'
items.summaryShort: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand'. Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years.
